# BLS survey series file excerpts (test fixtures)

Hand-built excerpts in the column layout of BLS's survey series catalogs
(`https://download.bls.gov/pub/time.series/{cu,ce,la,ln}/*.series`), a few rows each, for the
BLS adapter's discovery tests. They are not recorded downloads and are never used as reference
data by the crawler; the product fetches the real files from BLS.
